Jean-Loup Gabert, inspecteur stagière de Grazzi

His True Shocking Story...Filmed with Bullet Force!

HE WAS A BACHELOR ON A PERPETUAL HONEYMOON!

How many dates does it take to find love?

Working Girls-Here's Your Picture About Your Lives—Your Problems!

There's More To The Legend Than Meets… The Throat!

But Antoine has drastically underestimated the mess that four mischievous kids can cause...

...Mother and daughter in love with the same man ... rivals in ruthlessness even to murder!

A Place of Total Despair. All the youthful beauty of Europe enslaved for the pleasure of the 3rd Reich.

Making friends is easy, keeping them is impossible...

An elite army of female assassins...in a race against time and death to save the world from a hideously diabolical mass destruction at the hands of a madman no one had ever seen!

MANDINGO lit the fuse... DRUM is the explosion!

One lost monkey on the journey of a lifetime

The Real Life Adventures Of A Make-Believe Cop.

When the government hides the truth... all bets are off.
